data.summary: get in, learn what you can, move on
data.pros:
* remote work... though with early signs of getting wound down
* some great ICs around ... if they havent disappeared overnight
* still decent perks and okay pay
data.cons:
* rate of people disappearing and accounts deactivated has been increasing. have to keep an eye on canvaworld farewell section to see who got purged this week
* performance culture squeeze is increasing. its an employers market and everyone is aware of it. faang bar without faang pay
* remuneration is okay but has been stagnant for some time. missed the boat to ipo and no liquidity event on the horizon.
* most of the orgs feel rudderless. middle management doing their best Elaine dance to the AI… [560 chars total]
